events.title: Fifth Third plans 502 layoffs at former Comerica campus in Farmington Hills
events.body: The layoffs are expected to begin in July. Fifth Third finalized its purchase of Comerica in February.

events.title: Why Fifth Third Bancorp (FITB) is a Top Dividend Stock for Your Portfolio
events.body: Dividends are one of the best benefits to being a shareholder, but finding a great dividend stock is no easy task. Does Fifth Third Bancorp (FITB) have what it takes? Let's find out.
